name: Ink Lens on the focus region of the active segment
description: Chase Hendrick's Ink Lens on VC3D's focus region of the active segment, through the tool registry (python -m kit tools run ink-lens): an openly licensed 9 um ink model in both depth orders on this computer's CPU, keeping only ink above the region's own reverse-depth control. It writes only into this run's folder, never into the segment folder, and VC3D loads the kept ink as a new ink detection; the control and the letter-candidate pins come back with Scrolls > Open run output. Fetch the reader once first: python3 spaces/ink-lens/engine.py fetch d9v2. Model output, not a reading.

inputs.name: voxel_um
inputs.label: The render's pixel size in micrometers (auto: from the volume)
